svg.title: The Tree of Life - Golden Dawn Correspondences
svg.desc: A2 reference poster with ten Sephiroth, twenty-two connecting paths, Boaz and Jachin pillars, Queen Scale spheres, King Scale paths, divine names, archangels, angelic orders, spiritual experiences and virtues. Daath has no disputed entries.
svg.metadata: {"title": "The Tree of Life - Golden Dawn Correspondences", "page_mm": [420, 594], "png_dpi": 300, "convention": "Sephiroth: Queen Scale; connecting paths: King Scale. Golden Dawn Tarot order.", "sources": [{"title": "Dion Fortune, The Mystical Qabalah, chapters XV-XXV", "url": "https://www.globalgreyebooks.com/online-ebooks/dion-fortune_mystical-qabalah_complete-text.html"}, {"title": "Aleister Crowley, Liber 777, original Golden Dawn attributions, Table I, columns XIV-XVI; Table IV", "url": "https://www.tarrdaniel.com/documents/Thelemagick/aa/documents/Student_Reading_Curriculum/02_Liber_777_DCCLXXVII_Revised.pdf"}, {"title": "Golden Dawn, Book T - The Tarot", "url": "https://benebellwen.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/02/mathers-and-felkin-golden-dawn-book-t-the-tarot-1888.pdf"}], "editorial_notes": ["Daath is retained only as an unnumbered positional marker. No divine name, archangel, angelic order or star is assigned.", "Chokmah includes Yah (YH), the usual 777 attribution, and YHVH, the form printed by Fortune.", "Malkuth uses Fortune's Vision of the Holy Guardian Angel, avoiding conflation with the distinct formula Knowledge and Conversation.", "Hebrew is unpointed. Transliteration varies by author; conventional English spellings are used.", "Colour swatches approximate traditional named colours; no universally standardized RGB or CMYK values are implied.", "Primary realm legend refers to divine name, archangel, angelic order and mundane sphere, not to four differently coloured whole Trees.", "The supportive pillar ornament is architectural decoration, Vision of God face to face
Vision of Harmony; Mysteries of the
Vision of the Machinery of the Universe
Numbers 11-32 on the Tree · Joins = Sephirah numbers
Sources: Dion Fortune, The Mystical Qabalah, chs. XV-XXV; Liber 777, Tables I and IV; Golden Dawn, Book T.
Golden Dawn Tarot order. Daath is unnumbered; disputed entries omitted. Traditional colour names are approximated for print.
